trigger: The permitted HAI 21.03 normal headers use historical names for signals that the HAI technical manual identifies as the same physical quantities in HAI 23.05. Using a literal name intersection would discard setpoints and vibration channels that are central to the documented attacks.
permitted_change: Replace the literal-name intersection with the ordered canonical map below. No final-file header, value or label has been accessed.

P1_B2004.basis: matching 0-10 bar setpoint role and observed normal range

P1_B3004.basis: matching water-level setpoint role and 300-400 mm normal range

P1_B3005.basis: matching discharge-flow setpoint role and 950-1050 l/h normal range

P1_B4002.basis: matching outlet-temperature setpoint role and 28-33 degree normal range

P1_B400B.basis: matching water-outflow setpoint role and 0-3190 l/h range

P1_B4022.basis: matching thermal-power temperature demand and 25-28 degree normal range

P2_ASD.basis: HAI manual historical name for auto speed demand

P2_MSD.basis: HAI manual historical name for manual speed demand

P2_VYT02.basis: explicit HAI manual historical vibration-channel name

P2_VXT02.basis: explicit HAI manual historical vibration-channel name

P2_VYT03.basis: explicit HAI manual historical vibration-channel name

P2_VXT03.basis: explicit HAI manual historical vibration-channel name

excluded_non_equivalences: P4_HT_LD is not aliased to total load P4_LD
P2_HILout and P2_SIT02 have no documented HAI 23.05 equivalent
P1_B4005 has no sufficiently supported HAI 23.05 alias
authority_boundary: Canonicalization changes only the evidence model input schema. It does not change runtime authority or convert recorded HIL evidence into certification.
